0.long_answer: While Morquio syndrome is generally associated with normal intelligence, the development of untreated hydrocephalus can negatively impact cognitive function. Hydrocephalus, which is the buildup of cerebrospinal fluid in the brain, can lead to increased intracranial pressure and potentially cause neurological damage if not treated effectively. In individuals with Morquio syndrome, hydrocephalus represents an important complication to monitor, as its untreated progression may result in diminished intellectual abilities.
